rules.description: Administrator MFA required vs optional stance must align between canonical and row
rules.messageTemplate: Administrator MFA requirement contradicts the approved canonical answer
rules.resolutionGuidance: Align admin MFA enforcement with the canonical policy or update the canonical answer.

rules.description: End-user MFA enabled vs not enabled / required vs optional must align between canonical and row
rules.messageTemplate: End-user MFA assertion contradicts the approved canonical answer
rules.resolutionGuidance: Match end-user MFA posture to the canonical policy.

rules.description: When both answers name a primary MFA method, the method family must match (e.g. WebAuthn vs SMS-only)
rules.messageTemplate: Supported MFA method in the row does not match the method emphasized in the canonical answer
rules.resolutionGuidance: List the same primary MFA methods as the canonical policy (e.g. phishing-resistant vs SMS).

rules.description: When canonical enumerates MFA methods, the row should name at least one supported method
rules.messageTemplate: Canonical lists specific MFA methods but the row does not mention any supported method
rules.resolutionGuidance: Mirror the method list from the canonical answer or update canonical if offerings changed.

rules.description: Row must not claim weak MFA-only patterns when canonical emphasizes strong factors (row-only heuristic)
rules.messageTemplate: Row cites weak MFA patterns that conflict with phishing-resistant expectations in admin MFA policy
rules.resolutionGuidance: Prefer WebAuthn, hardware keys, or other phishing-resistant factors per canonical guidance.
